purpose: Exact reviewed dispositions for residual named identity surfaces exposed by the recursive adversarial Schedule guard after normal actor/project/scope identity resolution.

semantics.source_binding: Every residual source is pinned directly by schedule-residual-identity-source-pins-v1.json. Where a normal Schedule disposition also pins that source, both independent review surfaces must pin the identical Git blob.
semantics.covered: The exact residual parser surface is represented by the listed identity already bound on the same reviewed audited row. This is identity coverage only and creates no new role, relation, evidence, culpability or governance inference.
semantics.deferred: The exact residual surface remains explicitly identity-deferred. On normal actor/project/scope rows this overlay is valid only for rows already controlled by a reviewed disposition; extra-context fields may carry residual-only deferral. Deferral records representation debt only; it is not an evidence, participation, culpability or governance judgment.
semantics.non_inference: No entry changes R/S/U/N, Schedule scope, participation, hierarchy, control, membership, operation or supply semantics.
